title: Healey unveils £100 for energy bills and bank tax in first Budget
description: The chancellor targets the cost of living amid global economic turmoil but opposition parties say he has not been bold enough.

title: I earn £30,000. I'm angry there was no fuel duty cut in the Budget
description: People on a range of incomes from £4,062 to £150,000 a year tell the BBC what they made of this year's Budget.

title: High-speed train crash kills at least 68 people in Spain
description: The crash, between a moving train and another that was stopped further up the track, was caused by an "inexplicable" error, the transport minister said.

title: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show
description: With 85% of ballots counted, Netanyahu's Likud party and its allies are set to win 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset.

title: Flávio Bolsonaro denies fleeing Brazil after landing in Miami
description: The defeated Brazilian candidate claims to be the victim of a coup d’état and political persecution, recycling unsubstantiated allegations of “electoral fraud”.

title: Death of US actress Hayden Panettiere ruled accidental, ending local police probe
description: The Heroes and Nashville star died in August from the toxic effects of fentanyl, Xanax and several other drugs.

title: Family row over George Michael items up for auction - including Faith guitar
description: The brother of the singer's late personal assistant says she would not have wanted the items to be sold.

title: King Charles shows off dance moves on second day of Caribbean tour
description: Earlier in the day, the King paid his respects to the island's fallen servicemen and women.

title: Details of thousands of US immigration agents leaked in major hack
description: A group called the Department of Peace released information on more than 41,000 DHS staff.
